theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiTM_blowUp_defect_tendsto_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (ν : Rn N → Rn N) (x e : Rn N) (ρ₁ : ℝ) (φ : Rn N → ℝ), 0 < ρ₁ → μ (Metric.ball x ρ₁) < ∞ → AEStronglyMeasurable ν μ → (∀ᵐ y ∂μ, ‖ν y‖ = 1) → ‖e‖ = 1 → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ (ρ ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ y in Metric.ball x ρ, ‖ν y - e‖ ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0) → Continuous φ → HasCompactSupport φ → Tendsto (fun r : ℝ ↦ (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ y, φ (blowUpMap x r y) ∂μ - (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ y, φ (blowUpMap x r y) * inner ℝ e (ν y) ∂μ) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
